description: This file defines the ProductDescription class, a JPA entity representing product description data, including fields for meta tags, highlights, external links, and its relation to a Product object.

classes.name: ProductDescription
classes.description: JPA entity class representing product description details with fields for metadata, highlights, and external links, linked to a Product entity.

methods.name: getProductExternalDl
methods.description: Returns the external download link for the product.

methods.name: setProductExternalDl
methods.description: Sets the external download link for the product.

methods.name: getSeUrl
methods.description: Returns the SEO URL of the product description.

methods.name: setSeUrl
methods.description: Sets the SEO URL of the product description.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product object with this description.
